strategies.name: vwap_20sma_long_pullback_continuation
strategies.entry_summary: On the 2-minute chart, get bullish once the first candle closes above both VWAP and the 20 SMA, then enter long on a following candle confirming that high or on pullbacks/bounces that test VWAP while price continues to hold above VWAP and the 20 SMA.
strategies.exit_summary: For a scalp, take profits into the upper VWAP band. For a runner, hold while VWAP and the 20 SMA trend higher and use the 20 SMA as a trailing stop, exiting on a close below the 20 SMA after price has separated upward from VWAP.

variants.target_note: can scalp into the upper VWAP band or hold with 20 SMA trailing stop

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: buy pullbacks into VWAP as long as price is testing/wicking around VWAP without closing below and building below it
variants.target_note: take profits into the upper VWAP band or continue holding while 20 SMA/VWAP trend higher
variants.transcript_quote: as long as we're not losing it closing below it and building below it this is a good buying opportunity

consensus.enumeration_note: The transcript gives one fully runnable long VWAP/20-SMA continuation framework with compatible entry variants (initial confirmation entry vs VWAP pullback entry) and two compatible management styles (band scalp vs 20-SMA trailing hold). The later short idea is not promoted because it lacks a concrete exit/stop rule.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: the first two-minute candle off the Bell closes over the 20 SMA and vwap
entry_sequence.action: On the 2-minute chart, wait for the first candle off the bell to close above both the 20 SMA and VWAP.
entry_sequence.rationale: The close over both indicators establishes the initial bullish condition.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: once we close over this 20 period moving average I'm looking for a following candle to confirm the high of that candle
entry_sequence.action: Enter long when a following candle confirms the high of the candle that closed above the 20 SMA.
entry_sequence.rationale: The follow-through confirms buyers are continuing higher after the initial close above the averages.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: as long as we're trading over vwap and as long as we're trading over this 20 SMA we can hold this position
entry_sequence.action: Also use pullbacks into VWAP as long opportunities while price continues holding above VWAP and the 20 SMA.
entry_sequence.rationale: The speaker treats VWAP retests as support while the broader bullish structure remains intact.

stop.transcript_quote: use the previous Wick as a stop
stop.rationale: The speaker says to use the previous wick or previous low point as the stop on the pullback entries.

strategies.stop_management: Use the 20 SMA as a trailing stop once price has broken away from VWAP and the 20 SMA is clearly trending higher; exit if price closes below the 20 SMA.

targets.transcript_quote: you can sell for profits into the upper Channel
targets.rationale: For a scalp, the speaker says to take profits into the upper VWAP channel.
